name: anim_koya_idle
subject: a slim, lean-muscled dog man made of glossy brown paint with broad diagonal cream bands, messy spiky brown hair with long bangs over one eye, yellow eyes, a sly closed-mouth smirk, a bushy brown tail with cream streaks, straight human legs with bare human feet
desc: Idle loop: slow calm breathing, the lean chest rises only slightly (subtle, not inflating), the shoulders roll a little, the bushy tail sways slowly, brown and cream paint keeps dripping from the chin, the neck, the hands and the tail tip, sticky drips stretch and fall, the body sways a little. Stays in place with both feet planted. The face keeps the same sly closed-mouth smirk. Thick, sticky, viscous paint.
